2.text: “Nimwumve ibyo mvuga mwa banyabwenge mwe,Namwe abajijutse muntegere amatwi,

3.text: Kuko ugutwi gusobanura amagambo,Nk'uko akanwa kumva ibyokurya.

5.text: “Yobu yavuze ati ‘Ndi umukiranutsi,Kandi Imana yankuyeho ibyari binkwiriye.

6.text: Nubwo nta rubanza rundiho mbarwa nk'umubeshyi,Uruguma rwanjye rurenze urukiriro,Nubwo nta gicumuro mfite.’

7.text: Mbese hariho umuntu umeze nka Yobu,Unywa gukobwa nk'ugotomera amazi?

8.text: Agenda yibanisha n'inkozi z'ibibi,Kandi akagendana n'abanyabyaha.

9.text: Kuko yavuze ati‘Nta cyo bimariye umuntu kwishimana Imana.’

10.text: “Nuko rero nimuntegere amatwi,Mwa bantu bajijutse mwe,Ntibikabeho ko Imana ikora ibyaha,N'Ishoborabyose ngo ikore ibyo gukiranirwa,

11.text: Kuko izitūra umuntu ibihwanye n'umurimo we,Izaha umuntu wese kubona ibihwanye n'imigenzereze ye.

12.text: Ni ukuri ntabwo Imana yakora ibibi,Kandi Ishoborabyose ntiyagoreka imanza.

13.text: Ni nde wayihaye gutwara isi?Cyangwa ni nde wayiringanirije ibyaremwe byose?

14.text: Yakwitegereza abantu,Ikisubiranira umwuka no guhumeka byayo,

15.text: Ibyaremwe byose byapfira rimwe,Umuntu na we agasubira mu mukungugu.

16.text: “Noneho niba ujijutse umva ibi,Utegere amatwi ijwi ry'amagambo yanjye.

17.text: Mbese uwanga gukiranuka yategeka?Wacira Ikiranuka kandi Ikomeye urubanza?

18.text: Birakwiriye se kubwira umwami uti ‘Uri mubi’?Cyangwa ab'imfura uti ‘Muri babi’?

19.text: Nkanswe kubibwira Imana itarobanura abami ku butoni,Ntiyite ku batunzi kubarutisha abakene,Kuko bose ari bo yaremesheje amaboko yayo.

20.text: Bapfa mu kanya gato ndetse mu gicuku,Abantu baradandabirana bakagendanirako,Kandi intwari zikurwaho ari nta muntu zizize.

21.text: “Kuko amaso yayo ari ku migenzereze y'umuntu,Kandi ireba amajya ye yose.

22.text: Nta mwijima cyangwa igicucu cy'urupfu,Aho inkozi z'ibibi zishobora kwihisha.

23.text: Kuko itagomba kongera kwitegereza umuntu,Kugira ngo yirirwe isubira mu rubanza.

24.text: Ivunagura intwari mu buryo butarondoreka,Igashyira abandi mu kigwi cyazo.

25.text: Kuko izi imirimo yazo,Kandi izubika nijoro zikarimbuka.

26.text: Izikubita nk'abantu babi,Ku mugaragaro imbere y'abandi barora,

27.text: Kuko zayiteshutse,Ntizite ku nzira zayo zose.

28.text: Bagatuma gutaka kw'abakene kuyigeraho,Kandi ikumva gutaka kw'abarengana.

29.text: “Iyo itanze amahoro ni nde wabasha gutera amahane?Iyo yitwikiriye ni nde wabasha kuyireba?Uko yagira benshi ni ko yagira n'umwe,

30.text: Kugira ngo utubaha Imana atima,Kandi ngo hatagira utega abantu umutego.

32.text: Icyo ntabonye ukinyigishe,Niba narakoze ikibi sinzongera kugikora.’

33.text: Mbese ingororano yayo uyangishwa n'uko idakora icyo ushaka?Kuko ari wowe ukwiriye guhitamo atari jye,Nuko vuga icyo uzi.

34.text: “Abantu bajijutse,Ndetse abantu bose bazi ubwenge banyumva,Bazambwira bati

35.text: ‘Yobu yavuze icyo atazi,Kandi amagambo ye ntiyarimo ubwenge.’

36.text: “Icyampa Yobu akageragezwa akazagezwa ku maherezo,Kuko asubiza nk'abanyabyaha.

37.text: Kuko yongera ubugome ku cyaha cye,Agakoma mu mashyi muri twe atangara,Akagwiza amagambo ye yibasiye Imana.”
